## Summary

Pin the shared Rolling Release writer to the published v0.8.0 revision and digest. Select `release-policy-v2` in the provider’s self-publication caller and CLI configuration. Consumers can adopt the updated shared workflow with their own reviewed configuration and historical replay pins.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Adopt the v2 release policy in Rolling Release and make the verified v0.8.0 writer available to callers.
impact: Build, maintenance, workflow, and refactor changes can start patch proposals under v2.
required_action: null
```

## Verification

- 955 behavioral tests, 22 architecture tests, formatting, lint, types, and the docs build passed in the local hook.
- A GET-only rehearsal with the staged v2 self-caller replayed the v1 predecessor with its original producer and confirmed the exact v0.8.0 tag and immutable GitHub Release were already present.

- The immutable GitHub Release and Git tag identify `b73b56364a92d546829a11865b9a7ed658daaabe`.
- The version and latest OCI aliases both resolve to `sha256:76665088945656f16240192f8cfa90dd6b7afa10b33045266a956b0b2bfe1d90`. The matching Linux/amd64 image names the same source revision. [Publication](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44996105695)

## Rollout

Existing consumers adopt the new shared pin and their selected policy in reviewed changes. Keep prior producers available for tagged historical replay. The provider’s switch may prepare its next patch proposal under v2.

pullRequests.body:
## Summary

Run the preview history installer from the same verified release commit as the writer. Replays that have a reviewed source pin and no image digest need this installer. The previous installer uses an older configuration parser, so it rejects v2 callers with source-only history.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Install reviewed preview history with the current release runtime.
impact: Consumers with source-only historical producers can use the same v2 workflow as consumers with image-backed producers.
required_action: null
```

## Verification

- The local hook passed 955 behavioral tests, 22 architecture tests, formatting, lint, types, and the docs build. The committed tree on current main matches that tested tree exactly.
- The shared-workflow contract checks that the installer uses the verified writer pin and runs before preview authentication.
- GET-only rehearsals selected a fresh v0.1.0 cycle for the staged website and Upkeep Bot configurations with writers paused.

## Rollout

Pin all five consumers to the same reviewed shared workflow after this correction. Existing release writers keep their immutable v0.8.0 pin and the normal preview stays read-only.
